other_conditions: Applicants must be students pursuing post‑graduate programmes (including integrated PG), doctoral degrees, B.E. or B.Tech. in Biotechnology or related life‑science subjects such as bioinformatics, molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry or genetics
Teams must consist of exactly five students, with at least three members having a life‑science background
Each team may submit only one entry and a participant can belong to only one team
Each team must nominate a team leader and may identify a mentor

Proposals must be in the core areas of biotechnology (e.g., agriculture, aquaculture, bio‑energy, biologicals, bioprocess engineering, biosensors, drug discovery, environment, food, medical diagnostics, nanobiology, nutraceuticals, vaccines, etc.)
benefits_summary: Cash awards of up to ₹1,00,000 for first prize, with second and third prizes of ₹50,000 and ₹25,000, plus start‑up facilitation and support for the winners.
